lines.t: intrinsically and intimately intertwined october 11th 2024 from yahushua hamashiach our lord and
savior the word of the lord spoken to timothy for the lord's little flock for a sister in christ
who is being accused of living as an adulterer because she was previously married and divorced
divorced and is now remarried. Thus says the Lord Yahushua, Is it right to destroy a new life for
the sake of an old one? Is it right to murder a child in the womb in an effort to regain a path
which was only imagined, a life which is yet to be and has not yet been? For you know not what
tomorrow will bring, nor can one grab hold of the future as though they can shape it to their own
liking, for they know not what tomorrow will bring. Dreams and aspirations are indeed good,
a gift given you when I made you at the first, when I set you apart from every living creature
that dwells upon the earth. And what of the path of the new person shall you prevent them from
walking it? What of the dreams and aspirations of the person not yet born from the womb are
are theirs any less valid because they have yet to consider them? Is it right to rob them of their
life because someone has told you that it is your body, your choice? In the same way, is it right to
destroy the life you have for the sake of that which has been, or for fear of that which might
be, though only imagined? Are there not other lives involved, yea, many who are affected by
your decisions? Or is it your life, your choice, by which you selfishly invalidate the lives of
those connected to yours? For I tell you the truth, they are intrinsically and intimately
intertwined. Therefore again I say to you, see with greater eyes. For as it is written,
the very moment one has a change of heart, do they pass from judgment into life, the same moment
when all that went before is remembered no more, the moment when all who come to me in sincere
repentance are made new, becoming a caretaker of that which is and shall be, a wise servant
who is careful not to repeat their sins of the past as they look to the day, their eyes fixed
upon the goal. Therefore let no one steal from my glory nor pollute my name any more. Let no one
attempt to make my sacrifice of no effect, for they know not on whose behalf they speak,
unaware of whose mouthpiece they have become. Rather pray for them, yet listen not to their
dark speeches, for they do always bear false witness of me as they cease not from misusing
the Scriptures, lacking knowledge, stumbling always over the letter focused only on the
accusation, though they themselves are guilty of the same, forgetting that you are washed,
that you are sanctified, justified in my name, as it is written, I am the Lord.
